title: Caesars Republic Lake Tahoe is Officially Open Debuting a Bold New Era of Luxury on the South Shore
summary: Champagne toasts, a celebratory ribbon cutting and immersive live performances marked the resort’s highly anticipated grand opening celebration on July 6 For hi-res images and b-roll of the Grand Opening, please click here F or hi-res images of the Resort, please click here Caesars Entertainment officially unveiled Caesars Republic Lake Tahoe Hotel Casino last night, ushering in a bold new era for the South Shore with a grand opening celebration that signals the arrival of a modern, high-energy, luxury destination in the Sierra Nevada. Lisa Vanderpump cuts the ribbon at the Grand Opening of Caesars Republic Lake Tahoe with Karie Hall, Anthony Carano, Gary Carano and Stew Massie. Credit: Caesars Entertainment The resort hosted an evening designed to match the scale of its transformation, welcoming guests with a champagne reception before a ceremonial ribbon-cutting with longtime partner Lisa Vanderpump, culminating in a celebratory moment in the stunning Caesars Republic lobby.
